Fact: design_rationale
What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Cascade RL combines offline RL (MPO) as an efficient warm-up to reach satisfactory results and guarantee high-quality rollouts, then online RL (GSPO) to refine the output distribution using the model's own rollouts, giving significant gains at a fraction of the GPU time cost. GSPO was chosen without reference model constraints because it was found more effective for training both dense and MoE models. NTP loss is re-weighted by square averaging to mitigate bias toward longer or shorter responses. Reasoning data in Thinking mode is included to instill long-thinking capabilities, with incorrect-answer rollouts filtered out.
quotes: Specifically, we first fine-tune the model using an offline RL algorithm as an efficient warm-up stage to reach a satisfied results, which can guarantee the high-quality rollouts for the latter stage.
Compared to the single offline or online RL stage, our cascaded RL achieves significant performance improvements at a fraction of the GPU time cost.
During the online RL stage, we employ GSPO, without reference model constraints, as our online RL algorithm, which we find more effective in training both dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.
